note:
The subject is the nightly drift pull request carrying everything the scan regenerated. The job runs two measurements — the baseline from a released Go SDK, the contracts from the documents the providers serve — and until 2026-11-12 it uploaded only the first, so the second died with the runner. Measured: the branch the nightly pushed on 2026-11-09 (97c54a0) holds README.md and two files under coverage/ and nothing under contracts/, and contracts/scaleway.json had not moved since 2026-10-19 (#803) while the documents moved under it. A fresh extraction on 2026-11-12 answered +328 lines, holding the two baremetal commitment operations a triage was waiting for and twenty-one newly declared query parameters, six of them on served routes that were dropping them silently (#884).

Nothing in the repository would have said it. The issue reports what is undecided, and a contract that never travelled leaves nothing undecided to report, so the signal was absent rather than ignored. An outside contributor hit it as a side effect.

The defect had three independent halves and fixing one leaves the mechanism dead, which is why all three are mutated here plus the job's own condition: a path the artefact does not carry, a path propose does not stage, and a condition keyed on the coverage half alone — that last one uploaded nothing at all on a descriptions-only night, and the download one job over then failed on a missing artefact.

mutations.label: the artefact stops carrying contracts/, which is the state of the repository on the day this was found: the step regenerates the descriptions, says so in the summary, and uploads everything except them

the upload is keyed on the coverage diff alone, so a night where only the API descriptions moved uploads nothing and the download in propose fails on a missing artefact. The narrower half, and the one a path alone cannot fix
mutations.find:
- name: Upload the refreshed coverage
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true' || steps.contracts.outputs.changed == 'true'
mutations.replace:
- name: Upload the refreshed coverage
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'

mutations.label: propose stops staging contracts/, so the pull request is born without the half the artefact now carries — the same shape as the README staleness this job already paid for
mutations.find: git add coverage/ contracts/ README.md README.fr.md docs/
mutations.replace: git add coverage/ README.md README.fr.md docs/ # contracts/

mutations.label: the artefact stops carrying README.fr.md, which `feint docs` writes as well through spliceTranslatedBanner. It is the same defect one path over, and it had not fired yet only because the translated banner counts mounted routes while a baseline refresh mounts none

the propose job runs on the coverage half alone, so a descriptions-only night opens no pull request at all. The accepting half is asserted with it: a condition that fired every night would teach everyone to close these unread, which is the failure the mechanism exists to avoid
